There's a hard cap of 5 minutes per session, which I cannot believe more people aren't concerned with, but I guess it's the type of work they do. This works really well for 30-second and 1-minute sections, but when I want to do things like dictation for work purposes, reports, or writing, it just stops after 5 minutes of dictation into any form (whether its regular notes or its notepad). That is not useful to me.

The other thing I'll note is that its pure dictation is no better than Apple's native voice memos, and if you were to paste that stuff into almost any major LLM for cleanup, you'll get just as good a result. This is an app whose purpose is shrinking every minute.
